name: Strategic foresight calibration
purpose: Review reasoning, not a required winning ID. Examples are authored illustrations, not observed model outputs. Scenario labels and review criteria are not sent to the model.

cases.name: Karthus with zero reported AP and no items
reviewCriteria: Compare immediate Ultimate Awakening benefit with midgame and plausible late-game Eureka value if AP purchases follow; zero AP must not end the comparison.
Use the supplied 30% AP-to-haste relationship as fact, but do not invent a future AP total, guaranteed game length or exact Requiem cooldown.
Compare ultimate uptime separately from temporary post-R basic haste/reset value. Consider Q cadence and Defile's aura/resource pattern; missing Q cooldown means no quantified throughput claim.
Give a condition for preferring the alternative: immediate fights/earlier power versus time and commitment to AP itemization.
Do not invent Ultimate Awakening haste amounts, buff duration or internal cooldown; the pinned description omits these.

primary.name: Eureka
primary.reason: Little immediate value at 0 AP, but if you commit to AP purchases its 30% conversion can support later Requiem uptime as well as basic spells. Passing it gives up that scaling direction.

alternatives.name: Ultimate Awakening
alternatives.reason: Provides immediate ultimate haste and a post-R reset/window, though Defile's aura and mana drain limit what basic haste alone proves.
alternatives.preferWhen: You need earlier ultimate access and fight power before AP purchases can pay off.

illustrativeResponse.buildDirection: Favor AP itemization if taking Eureka; the payoff depends on reaching those purchases. For a repeated-Q pattern, assess actual cast cadence rather than treating basic haste as proportional damage.
warnings: The kit omits Q cooldown and the offered Ultimate Awakening description omits numerical haste/window values, so an exact cooldown or damage comparison is unavailable.

cases.name: Karthus with established AP scaling and high reported haste
reviewCriteria: Recognize owned Phenomenal Evil and ADAPt, existing AP items, and 600 reported AP as established synergy; do not assume future stacks or double-count item AP on top of reported AP.
Eureka's stated conversion at the reported AP is 180 nominal haste; compare practical marginal benefit with already high reported haste rather than promising proportional DPS.
Compare ultimate uptime, post-R basic windows and penetration as separate benefits; enemy MR and cooldown timings are unknown.
Either haste choice or penetration may win with a conditional explanation; no winning ID is prescribed.

primary.name: Thread the Needle
primary.reason: With 200 reported haste, penetration is a plausible immediate way to improve damage per hit while your owned AP scaling continues. Its value still depends on enemy defenses, which are not reported.

alternatives.name: Eureka
alternatives.reason: 600 reported AP implies 180 nominal haste from the stated conversion, with further conditional upside from AP growth; that is not a proportional damage increase.
alternatives.preferWhen: More Requiem and useful spell opportunities matter more than damage per cast.

alternatives.name: Ultimate Awakening
alternatives.reason: Offers ultimate haste and a post-R basic reset/window, but the snapshot cannot establish the numerical advantage over Eureka.
alternatives.preferWhen: The immediate post-R reset/window is especially useful in your fights.

illustrativeResponse.buildDirection: Continue the established AP direction; do not add owned item AP again to reported AP or assume future Phenomenal Evil stacks.
warnings: Enemy MR, ability cooldowns and Ultimate Awakening numerical values are absent; this is a conditional tradeoff.

cases.name: Vayne with six physical/attack items and zero reported AP
reviewCriteria: Do not apply the Karthus example as a universal Eureka ranking; the owned physical build gives no established future AP direction.
Compare Final Hour and Tumble's supplied interaction with post-R basics rather than assuming all damage scales with haste.
Respect the crit-cap constraint and avoid assuming an imminent end solely from six occupied slots; remaining game duration is unknown.
An AP pivot remains hypothetical, with substantial build opportunity cost; do not assert replacement purchases are already planned.

primary.name: Ultimate Awakening
primary.reason: Immediate ultimate haste and a post-R basic window plausibly support Final Hour and Tumble in the existing attack build. Eureka offers little at 0 AP and would need an unsupported AP pivot.

alternatives.name: Thread the Needle
alternatives.reason: Armor penetration can help physical hits, but does not increase Silver Bolts' stated true damage.
alternatives.preferWhen: Physical damage per hit against enemy defenses matters more than ultimate access or the post-R window.

alternatives.name: Eureka
alternatives.reason: AP-to-haste scaling is real, but this inventory and owned augment do not establish AP growth.
alternatives.preferWhen: A deliberate AP build pivot becomes worthwhile despite the cost of changing the current direction.

illustrativeResponse.buildDirection: Support the established attack build; capped crit has no intrinsic benefit and extra nominal basic haste does not imply proportional attack damage.
warnings: Ultimate Awakening amounts and timings are absent, so the practical gain remains conditional.

cases.name: Karthus with unknown AP/haste and an unresolved flat-AP offer
reviewCriteria: Missing AP and haste are unknown, not zero; an owned AP item supports direction but does not prove total current AP.
Compare future AP growth with immediate ultimate access conditionally; do not calculate exact current haste gain from incomplete stats.
Keep the existing missing-description-detail warning for Witchful Thinking; do not invent its unresolved AP amount.
Retain legal candidates and situational alternatives even when numerical certainty is low.

primary.name: Eureka
primary.reason: Blasting Wand supports an AP direction, so Eureka's AP-to-haste conversion may pay off now and as AP grows. Your total current AP is unknown, and the later payoff depends on continued AP purchases.

alternatives.name: Ultimate Awakening
alternatives.reason: Offers immediate ultimate haste without needing AP growth, plus a conditional post-R basic window.
alternatives.preferWhen: Earlier ultimate access matters more than the uncertain AP-scaling payoff.

alternatives.name: Witchful Thinking
alternatives.reason: Flat AP could improve the AP direction, but the supplied amount is unresolved.
alternatives.preferWhen: The in-game AP amount is known and direct spell power is the priority.

illustrativeResponse.buildDirection: Continue AP itemization if taking Eureka; compare Requiem access separately from Q cadence and Defile's mana-limited aura.
warnings: Current AP/haste, Q cooldown and Ultimate Awakening values are unavailable; Witchful Thinking's AP amount is unresolved.
